title: A quasilinear PCP theorem for PPAD

result.label: A quasilinear PCP theorem for PPAD
result.statement: Resolves the quasilinear PCP-for-PPAD conjecture. An End-of-Line instance of length N reduces to numerical circuit constraints of total length N( N)^ O(1) such that any polynomially encoded rational assignment satisfying all but a fixed fraction to fixed accuracy yields an endpoint solution. Such assignments always exist, giving robust local verification with only quasilinear size overhead.
